title: knowledge update paper framing route b

content.text:
paper_framing.md 已重写为 Route B negative result + mechanistic insight 叙事。核心变化:

- **Title**: 从 "ThreadGate: Recovering..." 转为 "Why Residual Gating Fails to Fix..."
- **Story Arc**: 从 solution paper 转为 "principled design → training success → inference failure → three coupled failure mechanisms"
- **Claims**: C1-C5 重组为 GAR 衰减确认、训练-推理断层、三个失败机制、四路消融无增量、跨模型验证
- **Selling Points**: 从 "首个有效方案" 转为 failure mode taxonomy、系统性探索 (v1-v7)、与 Dongre convergent evidence
- **Reviewer Concerns**: 新增 novelty of negative result、30x gap 是否 bug、actionable 建议等
- **新增 §10 竞争力评估**: Findings ~70%，加跨模型验证有冲 main 可能
